stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024): 14,933 applicants, 14,545 admitted (97%), 1,419 enrolled (1,397 full-time plus 22 part-time). CSUMB's Common Data Set is only available through a data request form on its site, so GPA, residency and international splits are not shown. College Navigator lists SAT/ACT as 'Not considered (Test Blind)', so there are no score ranges. Undergraduate enrollment is the College Navigator count for fall 2024.
